label: Surface versus volume discretization
subgoals: Choose a surface method when the medium is simple
Choose a volume method when materials are inhomogeneous
Weigh dense compressed matrices against large sparse ones

label: Time domain versus frequency domain
subgoals: Prefer time domain for broadband responses in one run
Prefer frequency domain for resonant or narrowband structures
Use adaptive sweeps to limit the number of frequency solves

label: Matching the solver to the extraction task
section: Matching the solver to the extraction task
subgoals: Classify the task by size, frequency and physics needed
Map quasi-static tasks to capacitance or PEEC solvers
Reserve full-wave solvers for wavelength-sized structures
